name: Acsalag (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Acsalag: a green and red shield with a white horse and a figure, inscribed ACSALAG on a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
